Description: About Block Labs Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming . We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong. The role We are building the frontend of a multi-brand consumer platform in React, Next.js and TypeScript: one codebase serving several brands, where launching a brand should be a matter of configuration, not a copy. You will be the most senior frontend engineer in the company and the person the platform’s UI depends on. We don’t hire into squads. We work as a small number of very strong individual contributors, each owning a product end to end and shipping with AI agents at a pace that used to take a team. You get an outcome and constraints, not a backlog: you find the decisions nobody has made, scope the work, build it, ship it and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. Product ideas often arrive as working prototypes built with AI tools by people outside engineering. Your job is to steer them into production, not to reject them or rebuild them from zero. Key Responsibilities: Own the frontend end to end: architecture, conventions, quality bar and production behaviour of a multi-brand platform, with no spec handed to you. Make adding a brand a configuration change: theming, brand-aware routing and content, and clean boundaries between shared and brand-specific code, all on a live product. Build and own the design system and component library that engineers, designers and AI-assisted prototyping all draw from. Turn product prototypes into production features fast, and build the workflow and tooling that make this repeatable. Ship with AI coding agents every day as your main way of working, with the checks that keep quality high at agent speed, and raise the bar for how others use them. Ship consumer-facing UI with real attention to detail, performance and accessibility. Take UX and product concerns straight to the people who own the product, with alternatives and working examples, not just objections. About You: 8+ years building production consumer-facing web applications, several of them at Staff or equivalent ownership. You have taken a frontend from a rough brief to production and owned it, and you can say exactly what was yours, what was your team’s and what was your agents’. AI coding agents are how you build, not a helper. You have your own setup and can say precisely where agents make you faster, where they produce plausible but wrong output, and how you catch it. Deep expertise in React, Next.js and modern TypeScript, with clear opinions on rendering strategies and when each is the wrong choice. Hands-on experience building or re-architecting multi-brand, multi-tenant or white-label frontends. You have built or owned a design system and can discuss consistency versus flexibility, adoption and governance. Strong UI and UX sensibility: you notice the small things and fix them without being asked. Comfortable working with non-engineers who build with AI tools, and you design for their output to be usable. Demonstrable Core Web Vitals work in production. You thrive with autonomy and light process, and you write clearly. Strong command of written and verbal English. Nice to have Experience with real-time, high-interaction consumer interfaces where latency and feel matter. Background in fintech, crypto, real-time gaming and entertainment platforms, or other high-traffic consumer products. Tooling, skills or integrations you built so agents work better inside a specific codebase or design system. Working knowledge of CI/CD and cloud environments. What this role is not Not a management or lead role. Influence comes from what you ship. Not a pure architecture role. You write production code every day. Not for someone who wants a team, a backlog or a complete spec before starting. What kind of culture can I expect? Mature, mission-driven, and low-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here. Description: TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity! The work: We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. Who we hire — the DNA Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama. Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we. No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast. What You Will Do: The role: Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels. This is the product wedge — what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes." Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. What you'll own: React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill) · WebSocket-driven real-time UI · plugin / module-federation patterns Screen-real-estate management The design system in code Your committed timelines. Who you are: A self-starter with a show-me mentality — you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups. You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes. Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature — consistency is what keeps a small team fast. You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity. You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning. What You Will Bring: 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ — You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering). Strong design/UI skills a +++ — you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand. Real Chrome Extension experience — Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote. Strong API skills — you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync. Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream. Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience. Performance as a habit — render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck. State management under streaming data — optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution. Extension security fluency — CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak. Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff. Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults — agents live in this UI 8 hours a day. A master debugger in the browser — DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash. Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it). Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: About Rivet Rivet is an AI-native accounting company. In less than 3 years, we've built a T500 accounting company in the US, combining corporate and personal income tax, sales tax, R&D credits, and bookkeeping into a single, all-inclusive experience that eliminates the worst parts of tax season for real businesses and the people who run them. Our platform is designed to feel invisible: it guides clients through their tax to-dos, automates the drudgery for preparers, and gets out of the way when it's not needed. We measure success in time saved and returns completed, not vanity usage metrics. We run Rivet (the business) on Rivet (the platform) because owning the stack makes it possible to deeply embed AI into every step of our workflows, far more than our competition will ever be able to relying on third-party/off-the-shelf tooling. Our team of 75 supports more than 1,300 clients, including some of the most innovative companies in the US — Cursor, Cognition, and ModRetro — and their executives, investors, and employees. And while we may have just gotten started a little over two years ago, this isn't our first rodeo: Nick Abouzeid (cofounder & CEO) comes from Ramp, where he ran three of their Growth teams from $100M → $600M in ARR Kyle Christenson (cofounder & Head of Tax) comes from the IRS, where he spent six years as an auditor before leaving to start his own firm over a decade ago We're well-funded, growing quickly, and sustainable. We've raised over $7M to date, from investors like XYZ Ventures, Susa Ventures, Haystack Ventures, and 40+ executives from Ramp, Anduril, Physical Intelligence, & more. Why this role is different The product is the only part of tax season most of our clients ever see, and it runs through one design engineer today. Every module's back-end owner pairs with him on the UI, which makes him the shared dependency for every screen we ship. You'd be the second, and the two of you would split it. Ownership from first commit to production. Engineers design, build, ship, and maintain their work — no handoffs, no middle-management mazes. Decisions happen at the edge. Engineers talk to clients and tax preparers directly. We optimize for speed and context, not committee consensus. Clear is kind. We surface problems early, talk about tradeoffs openly, and don't sugarcoat. We're kind by being honest, not by being vague. Pragmatic stacks. We pick tools that solve real problems. If it doesn't help us ship faster, safer, or better, we don't use it. Skin in the game. We ship things we'd be proud to put our name on — and if something breaks, we own it and fix it fast. Our stack Six engineers today, four languages. You'd live mostly in the first two: Frontend: React and TanStack, deployed to Cloudflare Workers. Typed clients generated from protobuf. Platform: Go, as a modular monolith — Connect RPC over protobuf, Go Fx for wiring, sqlc and goose against Postgres, River Pro for background jobs, Watermill for pub-sub over RabbitMQ. AI and eval: Python, in their own repos — ModelBridge (a gRPC service for AI building blocks) and TaxBench, our internal eval suite. Legacy integration: a C# Windows agent that drives Drake, one of the tax platforms our industry never built APIs for. Infrastructure: AWS — ECS Fargate, Amazon MQ, AMP, Loki, Tempo — provisioned by Pulumi, itself written in Go. Around the edges: Buildkite for CI, OpenTelemetry throughout, Doppler for secrets, Linear for tracking. What you'll do Drive on our client-facing surface area end to end — the portal where clients hand over documents, answer questions, and watch a return move toward filed. Design, build, ship, and keep it working. Build the workspace our preparers live in all day. Roughly 75 accountants use our internal tooling for eight hours a day, four months a year. Speed and clarity are the whole product for them. Work closely with Anton, our design engineer, and the rest of our engineering team. Back-end isn't off-limits - you'll have the ability to build and influence how our entire product is built from end-to-end. Ship AI into the interface, not around it. Extraction, review, and suggestion flows only work if the UI makes it obvious what the model did and where a human needs to look. Talk to the people using it. Accountants are in our Slack; clients are one call away. Watch someone use what you built before you decide it's done. We're fully distributed — but if you want an office, we'll help you find one through our investor network. What makes you a fit 6+ years building production web applications, primarily in React Have owned a product surface end to end, including the parts after launch Can read and write enough backend code to unblock yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting Care about the unglamorous parts — loading states, error handling, what happens on a bad connection with a 40MB PDF Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, early-stage environment Excellent verbal and written communication skills Nice to haves Production experience with TanStack (Query, Router, Table) Deployed to the edge — Cloudflare Workers or similar Worked with generated clients from protobuf, gRPC, or Connect RPC Built document-heavy or upload-heavy interfaces, where files are large, messy, and occasionally encrypted Strong design sense, especially if you've shipped without a dedicated designer Built internal tools for operators who sit close enough to tell you what's broken Built tax-adjacent software — fund administration, payroll, accounting platforms, filing systems, anywhere a wrong number has consequences What we offer Benefits and meaningful equity A fully remote team, plus twice-yearly company offsites A well-funded, fast-moving environment with minimal layers of management A world-class client base that values your time and pays for the premium experience The chance to build production-grade software your teammates use and love every day We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: Trabaja en una StartUp dentro del área de Ciberseguridad Conversacional desde alguno de los países que opera, con contrato laboral en España y flexibilidad laboral. WOZTELL trabaja dentro del ecosistema de Meta como uno de los únicos 100 carriers del mundo desde 2019, y está formando un nuevo equipo de desarrolladores que se especializarán en dotar a nuestra plataforma para corporativos de las últimas tecnologías en seguridad. Buscamos personas capaces de trabajar sin una supervisión constante y que se orienten a tener su entregable el día y la hora acordado. Deberán sentirse cómodos en modo remoto ya que el squad al que pertenezcan estará en cualquier lugar del mundo. Si te gusta bucear, esquiar, aprender idiomas, o cualquier otra actividad y quieres elegir cuándo y donde hacerlo, ésta es tu oportunidad .Nuestro CTO para este proyecto, que ya hizo un EXIT en una startup, sólo te exigirá participar 15 minutos en el daily (sin excusas!) y entregar el día y hora acordado. A partir de ahí, tu tiempo es tuyo. El idioma oficial del equipo de desarrollo será siempre el español independientemente del país elegido para trabajar. Valoramos muy bien la disponibilidad a viajar e incluso el que te inscribas con compañeros, ya que la compañía prevé incorporar 40 personas y el que viajen en parejas o grupos puede facilitar la estancia en el país seleccionado. Actualmente existen vacantes en las áreas de Marketing, Ventas, Partnership, Customer Care, Customer Success, Analista de mercados, Gestores de proyectos, Formadores en tecnología, Administrativo y Desarrolladores:si deseas que tengamos en cuenta que te gustaría viajar con alguien que también aplica a una oferta cualquiera, puedes indicar el campo del formulario llamado "Viajaría con". Te contamos como será el proceso de incorporación: Tras revisar los datos aportados en la plataforma de contratación y realizar un par de entrevistas con RRHH y el CTO, si tenemos acuerdo, se realizará un contrato laboral por todo 2024, y se iniciará la relación laboral. La decisión del país donde trabajar será tomada antes de realizar el contrato y no podrá ser cambiada durante el contrato, por lo que para aquellos desarrolladores que trabajen fuera del HQ (Valencia, España), podrá existir un período de un mes de formación en remoto o en el HQ, según su localidad de residencia. El contrato laboral estará dado de alta en la Seguridad Social de España cumpliendo derechos y obligaciones acorde a su legislación. Description: Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale. That’s why we created what3words . We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations. Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world. Who we’re looking for Based in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for an experienced Front End Engineer who knows code, and enjoys creating engaging experiences that people love to use. At what3words , we're proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You'll be exposed to technologies such as ReactJS, Docker, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS Lambdas, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Athena, BigQuery, Java, Scala, C++, and Swift. This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative, ambitious and Agile team, at one of the most exciting times in this company's life. Requirements: This role will focus primarily on the development of our map site, account management system, and other websites to support and showcase what3words ’ offerings. You will also work closely with our product and UX teams, receiving and inputting on designs and feasibility checks, and bringing fresh ideas to make what3words a better solution. You will have good experience of building sleek user interfaces on top of RESTful web APIs, using React, JavaScript, CSS. You will be able to work independently, self-motivate, collaborate well with others and keep calm under pressure. What we expect: Strong experience with ES6, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS. Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English. A passion for software engineering and continuous learning. Solid track record of building responsive sites for desktop, tablet and mobile. Bonus points for: Knowledge of Next.js, Google Maps or Leaflet, GIS systems, AWS, Kubernetes, or similar systems. Experience of Agile working environments. The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office . While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work with your main office timezone). Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Seven or more years of professional software-development experience. Five or more years of experience building production applications with React. Three or more years of experience developing enterprise applications with TypeScript. Strong experience with Material UI (MUI), including theming, component customization, responsive design, and design-system implementation. Demonstrated experience leading technical efforts and mentoring software engineers. Strong knowledge of modern front-end architecture, component-based design, HTML, CSS, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility. Experience integrating front-end applications with RESTful APIs. Experience with automated testing, Git-based workflows, and CI/CD practices. Experience participating in Agile planning, estimation, backlog refinement, and story development. Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, analysts, product owners, and stakeholders in a remote team environment. Preferred: Experience with Java, Spring Boot, SQL, and back-end API or service development. Experience creating, maintaining, or governing reusable component libraries and design systems. Experience with front-end testing frameworks and test-automation practices. Experience applying WCAG 2.1 and Section 508 accessibility standards. Experience optimizing front-end application performance and modernizing legacy enterprise applications. Experience supporting Department of Defense or other federal government programs. Active Secret security clearance. Active CompTIA Security+ certification. Description: BackerKit helps creators bring projects to life. For over a decade, we’ve powered some of the world’s most successful crowdfunding campaigns. We’re always building the next generation of our platform, innovating, and driving the industry forward. We’re a remote-first company of ~40 people with a diverse, close-knit team that prizes creativity, enthusiasm, and a willingness to learn. We move quickly, think deeply about our users, and care about building software that lasts. We’re looking for a full-time, Staff-level engineer who is deeply motivated by user experience, interaction design, and frontend craftsmanship and excited to bring that to life within a Ruby on Rails monolith. Perhaps this is you! The role This is a hands-on fullstack, product engineering role reporting to our Director of Engineering, Product, and Design. You’ll lead mainly through the code you write, review, and ship, and most of your week should be devoted to the team’s queue. We are looking for a UX- and business-minded engineer to work directly in Rails views to simplify complex workflows, create intuitive user experiences, and help transform the crowdfunding landscape. You’ll help shape frontend patterns across the product, and turn our powerful, interconnected systems into intuitive experiences that are fast, clear, and approachable. This role is high-context, high-collaboration, and high-impact. You’ll evolve patterns, raise the quality bar through mentorship and code review, and influence how the entire Engineering, Product & Design team thinks about user experience. Everyone at BackerKit is customer-facing, and we expect everyone to get to know the creators and backers that we serve (plus, they are awesome, just like you!). How we build We iterate quickly, ship small experiments, and learn from customers. We use Claude Code, practice TDD, work in one-week iterations, and ship multiple times a day. We were a full-time pairing shop for over a decade, and pairing is still central to how we work. Right now we’re also experimenting with solo and cross-functional trio work as we figure out what a great product team looks like when everyone is also working alongside AI. Today we pair with intent: for complex or ambiguous work, knowledge transfer, onboarding, and a teammate’s growth. That balance is still evolving and may shift back toward more pairing, so we want someone who’s curious about how the team works today before helping us decide what comes next. We’re pragmatic. Speed matters, but it isn’t a goal on its own; we want a pace we can sustain while still doing quality work and shipping the most impactful features for our business. Crowdfunding has real urgency and some chaos, so built into our values is the ability to respond quickly when creators, backers, and colleagues need us. Our process keeps evolving, and we want your voice in it. As one of our most senior folks, you’ll bring strong opinions and your experience to those conversations. We’re highly collaborative, but we aren’t purely consensus-driven. BackerKit is a Ruby on Rails “majestic monolith” deployed on Heroku. The codebase has been around since 2012. Despite that, it is relatively well-factored and well-tested. We’ve been tending this garden for over a decade! We value simplicity, maintainability, communication, and shared ownership. We’re a remote-first team, and this role works the team’s shared hours, 9-5 Pacific. We work closely with teammates across the company and with the creators and backers we serve, so being reachable and ready to respond to what the day brings during those hours matters. What you’ll do Build alongside engineers, PMs, and designers in pairs, trios and solo, working on the most impactful features as we innovate the crowdfunding landscape Lead frontend architecture, evolving patterns incrementally from real, repeated cases Co-own features end to end, translating product and design intent into elegant, maintainable UI and following up on usage after launch Simplify complex workflows and improve usability, responsiveness, and performance Mentor engineers and set the bar for code quality through review, holding AI-generated code to a high standard Report to our Director and join their engineering leadership group, alongside our other Staff Engineer and our CEO (a founding engineer who still codes daily), to advise on priorities and shape technical direction. Carry your share of team rotations, including on-call, PR review, and meeting host, and take actual breaks and vacations, with no off-hours or weekend work required beyond your on-call shifts What we’re looking for Technical, craft, and process Deep experience building high-quality user interfaces, and recent hands-on coding Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, JS, and browser behavior Comfort working directly in Rails views, helpers, and partials Experience with or strong interest in Hotwire / Turbo / Stimulus Preference for simple, maintainable systems over unnecessary abstraction Values pairing, and genuine interest in exploring what that looks like in this new AI-enabled world (bonus if you’ve worked in a 100% pairing environment) Product & UX thinking Strong product and interaction design instincts Experience simplifying complex workflows Ability to work effectively with ambiguity Staff-level impact Experience shaping engineering patterns and conventions Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills Act as a go-to partner for complex or ambiguous frontend and UX challenges Ability to zoom out to systems (architecture and business-level) thinking while remaining comfortable bushwhacking in the weeds Comfort making your case on priorities, then committing to the decision once it’s made. Most successful candidates for this role have 10+ years of software development experience working on multiple complex software projects over time and 5+ years as a staff engineer, though we do not have a strict years-of-experience requirement. This role is a great fit if you Have deep knowledge of Ruby, Rails, and JavaScript Care deeply about how software feels to use Enjoy working across product, design, and backend concerns Prefer cohesive Rails applications over fragmented frontend stacks or SPAs Treat constraints as a creative tool Care about creators getting to make a living doing what they love This role is likely not a fit if you Prefer working in React, Vue, or SPA-heavy environments Prefer fully decoupled frontend/backend architectures Prefer long periods of solo or heads-down work Prefer to set your own priorities rather than work from a shared team queue Are looking for a part-time or contract role Compensation & benefits Full-time, salaried, remote-first position on a distributed team Competitive salary and stock option plan Medical, dental, vision, and 401k benefits (with employer match!) Stipends for supporting creators of your choosing Annual Learning and Development stipend to support your professional growth Family-friendly and focused on maintaining a healthy work/life balance Awesome work environment at a company with a huge opportunity Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet ~60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented groups tend to only apply when they check every box. If this role excites you – even if you don’t meet every requirement – we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our platform enables engineers to ask questions in plain English and receive explainable, verifiable answers traced directly back to the exact lines of source code. Rather than replacing engineers, we're building AI that helps them understand decades of complex software faster, with complete transparency and confidence. We're building an AI-native engineering platform supporting the modernization of mission-critical healthcare systems serving millions of Veterans nationwide. The product has executive sponsorship, committed users, a clearly defined mission, and a customer who knows exactly what success looks like. Our engineering team is intentionally small. Every engineer has significant ownership, meaningful influence over product direction, and the opportunity to help define how engineers interact with AI. Develop the rendering pipeline for streaming AI responses, markdown, source citations, code blocks, dependency graphs, workflow visualizations, and technical documentation. Build evidence and traceability experiences that allow users to validate AI-generated answers by navigating directly to source code, documentation, and supporting artifacts. Design interaction patterns for agentic workflows, including multi-step reasoning, tool execution, progress visualization, human-in-the-loop review, and long-running AI tasks. Build responsive real-time user experiences using WebSockets, streaming APIs, and modern state management patterns. Partner closely with AI engineers to define how agent output is translated into intuitive user experiences. Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, architects, and platform engineers to rapidly prototype, validate, and deliver new capabilities. Build scalable component libraries and reusable design systems supporting future platform growth. Optimize performance, accessibility, responsiveness, and usability across enterprise environments, including Section 508 compliance. Instrument the application with analytics, observability, and client-side monitoring to continuously improve user experience. Use AI-native engineering workflows to accelerate development, improve software quality, and increase engineering velocity. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent professional experience). 7+ years of professional front-end software engineering experience building production web applications. Expert-level proficiency with React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and contemporary front-end architecture. Experience building highly interactive, data-rich user interfaces. Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, and scalable front-end engineering. Experience building real-time user experiences using streaming APIs, WebSockets, or Server-Sent Events. Experience consuming complex REST, GraphQL, tRPC, or comparable typed APIs. Experience collaborating closely with backend engineers, designers, and product teams in Agile environments. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly across engineering and business stakeholders. Mindset of a product engineer rather than a feature developer. Engineers capable of building software from first principles. Passion for usability, interaction design, and developer experience. Strong ability to carefully analyze requirements before writing code. Preference for ownership over narrowly defined responsibilities. Experience operating across the client/server boundary when necessary. Expertise using AI coding assistants, parallel agents, and model-driven development workflows. Efficiency while maintaining high engineering standards. Innate ability to solve difficult engineering problems that don't have obvious solutions. Nice to Have: Experience in healthcare, regulated industries, or large-scale enterprise modernization programs is a plus. Experience building AI-native products, LLM-powered applications, or agentic AI systems. Experience designing interfaces for AI assistants, copilots, developer tools, or knowledge platforms. Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, or agent orchestration frameworks. Experience rendering complex technical content including markdown, syntax highlighting, dependency graphs, diagrams, or code relationships. Experience developing products for software engineers or other highly technical users. Experience with cloud-native platforms including AWS or Azure. Experience building design systems or reusable component libraries. Familiarity with accessibility standards including Section 508 and WCAG. Experience using AI coding assistants and parallel AI workflows as part of daily software development. Why Join LTS? At LTS, we support impactful programs that directly improve healthcare services for Veterans nationwide. Our teams work on innovative modernization initiatives that help transform legacy systems into secure, scalable, and mission-focused digital solutions. Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling. Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way. Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e). Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues. Frontend fundamentals : complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design. Solid SQL in a backend context : schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse. Testing as a habit : you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright). Architectural judgment : you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack. DevOps fluency : containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux. Description: We're looking for an experienced Staff Frontend QA Automation Engineer to join our fast-growing tech team in HCMC, focusing on web applications and browser-based user journeys. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable frontend automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance web experience. Overview: Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale. That’s why we created what3words . We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations. Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world. The role: You’ll be joining our fast-growing tech team, focusing on our web applications, frontend user journeys, and browser-based experiences. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance experience. Conduct a mix of manual exploration and automated regression to find and report frontend-specific bugs, from flaky UI states and accessibility issues to broken journeys. Collaborate with Software Engineers and Product Managers to develop effective strategies and test plans for our web applications. Help troubleshoot issues in production and staging environments. Conduct post-release/post-implementation testing including regression, accessibility, and integration testing for frontend systems. Essential Skills: Frontend Automation : Experience building robust web automation frameworks using Playwright, with a focus on reliable end-to-end and cross-browser functional testing. Frontend CI/CD Integration : Experience integrating Playwright test suites into build pipelines, including parallel execution, test reporting, trace/video capture, and flaky test management. JavaScript/TypeScript Proficienc y: Strong JavaScript or TypeScript programming skills, with confidence building maintainable test frameworks and utilities. DevOps Ecosystem : Experience with build and configuration tools such as GitHub Actions and CircleCI. Browser & UI Savvy : A keen eye for frontend-specific nuances, including responsive behaviour, accessibility, browser compatibility, loading states, and visual consistency. Soft Skills : Excellent communication in spoken and written English, paired with a product mindset and rigorous attention to detail. Extra credit if you: Have worked with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular. Experience working with backend services. Experience with BDD and implementing Cucumber for automation. Have experience with accessibility testing, visual regression testing, or performance testing for web applications. Are able to understand the business context of what you’re doing – understand the value your work creates. Experience with Agentic AI workflows for testing. The role is based in our Ho Chi Minh office (at ///become.outlooks.rising). While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work on the HQ timezone). Description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users. What You'll Own Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows. Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products. Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms. Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling. Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely. Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes. What We're Looking For Strong backend engineering experience in production systems. Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations. Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale. Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset. Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability. Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks. People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk. Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements. Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems. People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

Demonstrated track record building and operating internal platforms or shared services consumed by multiple engineering teams. Advanced proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, Scala, Rust, or modern C++. Deep understanding of high-throughput messaging, streaming, and event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Pulsar, or NATS. Strong working knowledge of data storage systems across relational, key-value, document, and search workloads. Proven experience leading multi-quarter platform initiatives across teams, including stakeholder management and technical decision-making. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to author crisp technical design documents and present trade-offs clearly. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and shape engineering culture through code review, design review, and onboarding contributions. Our platform automates data exchange and workflows, helping governments and NGOs connect fragmented systems and deliver essential services across health, humanitarian response, and government programmes. Open Function Group, the platform’s primary steward, is a small, fully remote team of engineers, integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 15+ countries. We build infrastructure that helps governments function, clinics operate, and people access the services they depend on. The role Connecting two government systems should get easier every time. You’ll have the opportunity to make substantial technical contributions and the responsibility to see them through. Most of your time will be spent in the codebase, with design discussions, code review, and written proposals helping the team build on your work. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. Our stack is Elixir/Phoenix and Node.js. You’ll need Node.js experience; you can learn Elixir here. What you’ll do Ship production features Deliver features end to end, from technical proposal to production. Build the squad’s core capabilities: connected-system registration and governance, credential ownership and sharing, and high-performance workers that execute workflows reliably at scale. Shape OpenFn ’s backend architecture Set architectural direction across OpenFn ’s backend, including module boundaries, service interfaces, naming, and conventions. Establish consistent patterns that help engineers navigate and extend the codebase, including when using AI development tools. Set engineering conventions through code review, documentation, and your own work. Strengthen platform security Translate security findings into architectural changes and carry them through to production. Strengthen trust boundaries, isolation, and credential handling. Requirements What you’ll bring 8+ years of experience building and operating backend services for customer-facing products. Experience designing backend service architectures, not only extending existing ones. Experience building backend services with Node.js. Experience operating services where reliability and scale have direct consequences for users. The ability to work independently and collaborate across time zones in a small, distributed team, using GitHub, Slack, and written proposals. Clear, professional communication in English and the ability to work effectively across cultures. Useful additional experience Elixir/Phoenix or other languages and frameworks designed for functional programming or concurrency. Developer tooling or large migration programmes. Securing production systems. Work in health, humanitarian response, government digital transformation, or the wider social impact sector. Working proficiency in Spanish or French. Our NGO and government customer base means we don’t offer Silicon Valley pay scales; we aim to provide fair, transparent, and competitive pay. Flexible working hours. Fully remote work, with team meetups across Europe and Africa. Our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar. Significant influence on the platform’s architecture and the opportunity to help shape our technical strategy. The opportunity to build open source software that helps ensure everyone worldwide can get access to great digital public services. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Requirements Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast. Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology . We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: About the team Zillow is the top real estate website in the U.S., where millions of people come for help with their move. Description: Description MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare clinic setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi 's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality. We're looking for a Senior Backend (NodeJS) Engineer to join our AI Automation team and lead the development of AI-driven integrations within our telemedicine platform. You will design and scale the backend systems that connect our core product with AI services, directly improving how thousands of patients and providers interact with MEDvidi every day. You'll work at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, building production-grade systems that automate clinical and operational workflows. You'll collaborate closely with AI engineers, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ship reliable, scalable automation, from multi-agent orchestration to RAG pipelines. Responsibilities Design and build backend architecture for AI-powered automation systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and resilience. Integrate and scale LLM-based product features in close collaboration with AI engineers and product teams. Implement and evolve agent-based systems (e.g., ReAct, supervisor-agent models) supporting complex decision-making flows. Optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and context enrichment using structured and unstructured data. Develop robust APIs for internal services and external integrations. Ensure strong observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using tools like Grafana and OpenSearch. Participate in code reviews, contribute to architecture discussions, and maintain high-quality technical documentation for newly designed systems and APIs. Requirements 8+ years of commercial backend development with Node.js in product companies (preferably SaaS), with deep understanding of complex backend systems end-to-end. Strong experience designing backend architectures and technical solutions, including system decomposition, scalability trade-offs, long-term maintainability, and technology choices. Proven track record building scalable, high-performance backend systems and robust APIs, with solid understanding of data flows, failure modes, and performance bottlenecks. Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (not demos), with focus on reliability, predictability, cost control, and measurable quality improvements. Experience designing and implementing multi-agent AI workflows in production, including orchestration logic, ReAct patterns, supervisor-agent architectures, and clear understanding of when such approaches are justified. Practical experience with modern AI frameworks Solid experience designing and optimizing RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, ranking, chunking, and quality vs. latency trade-offs. Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured outputs (JSON/YAML), schema validation, evaluation-based iteration (e.g., AI eval frameworks), and reliability techniques beyond prompt-only solutions. Understanding of LLM infrastructure in production environments: tracing and observability (LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar), evaluation frameworks and quality metrics, tooling and orchestration, safety mechanisms and guardrails, performance and cost optimization. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, performance optimization) and AWS (CDK, Lambda, API Gateway, ElastiCache). Good understanding of observability and debugging (Grafana, OpenSearch, or similar). Strong engineering culture: testing, CI/CD, reliability, and technical ownership. Description: You'll build the software that connects engineering intelligence to the world's leading CAD platforms. If you've ever written Python that automated Siemens NX, CATIA, SOLIDWORKS, or Creo—or built backend services that process engineering design data—you'll likely find this work exciting. You'll design APIs, integrate CAD systems with cloud-native infrastructure, and build the backend powering AI-driven engineering workflows used to accelerate product design and manufacturing. This role combines software engineering, CAD automation, backend architecture and mechanical engineering in ways that are rarely found together ABOUT US: We are a MIT-born, venture-backed Silicon Valley startup building a real-life 'Jarvis'—an AI Copilot for design and manufacturing. Our goal is to utilize advanced AI, physics simulation, and computer graphics to reduce costs and improve engineering productivity across all steps of the design and manufacturing process. Responsibilities You'll help build systems that: Translate CAD models into machine-readable engineering data. Connect Siemens NX, CATIA, SOLIDWORKS and other CAD platforms with cloud-native AI services. Build scalable APIs that allow engineering applications to exchange geometry and metadata. Develop Python services that automate complex engineering workflows. Design backend systems that manage CAD assemblies, parts, configurations and engineering metadata. Partner with researchers building next-generation Engineering AI. What we're looking for BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering , or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience building and maintaining backend services and production software . Strong Python engineering skills with experience writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code . Experience developing software integrations using commercial CAD APIs , such as Siemens NX Open, CATIA, SOLIDWORKS API, Creo Toolkit, Autodesk Inventor API , or similar engineering platforms. Experience building cloud-native applications, backend APIs, and data models (including Protobuf). Experience working with 3D engineering data, CAD models, assemblies, and related engineering file formats . Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering, research, and product teams . You've built software using at least one commercial CAD API: Siemens NX Open CATIA SOLIDWORKS API Creo Toolkit Autodesk Inventor API Bonus Points Experience developing CAD automation tools, plugins or engineering software integrations. Familiarity with computational geometry, CAD workflows, PLM systems, or engineering data pipelines. Experience working with large-scale 3D models, assemblies or complex engineering datasets. Strong programming experience in C++ alongside Python. Experience designing and implementing gRPC-based APIs and distributed services. Experience building and deploying applications using Docker and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience implementing logging, monitoring, observability, and production debugging practices. Experience partnering with mechanical engineers, researchers, or AI/ML teams to build engineering applications. Passion for building software at the intersection of CAD, Mechanical Engineering, Backend Systems, and Engineering AI. Our tech stack Google Cloud Python, TypeScript Protobuf, gRPC , GitHub Actions Docker, Kubernetes, Spinnaker PostgreSQL Originally posted on Himalayas
